items.title_zh: AWS 首席 AI 和技术官马特 · 伍德：优秀的工程师要爱上问题，而非现成解法
items.title_en: AWS Chief AI and Technology Officer Matt Wood: Great Engineers Should Love the Problem, Not the Ready-Made Solution
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（12 日）晚间报道，亚马逊云科技（AWS）首席 AI 与技术官马特 · 伍德认为，真正优秀的工程师应该更关注要解决的问题，而不是执着于某一种解决办法。“我们希望工程师 不要太迷恋自己提出的具体方案，而是把更多热情放在问题本身 。” 在他看来，优秀工程师不会只用 AI 写代码， 还会利用 AI 深入分析问题，并尝试不同的解决思路 。 过去，软件开发成本较高，团队集中资源实施一种解决方案往往更划算。借助 AI， 开发者不仅能把问题研究得更透彻，还能同时尝试多种解决办法 。 亚马逊也在重新调整对软件工程师的要求。上个月，公司发布备忘录公布新版岗位指引，并提出“文艺复兴式开发者时代”的概念。新指引不再强调尽可能多地使用 AI，而是更加看重工程师 能够为客户和业务带来怎样的长期价值 。 以前，工程师可能要花上好几天等待代码审查、人工测试和设计修改。AI 能够生成代码后，工程师便可以把更多精力 放在复杂的审查工作上 。 伍德认为，不拘泥于某一种解决方案的工程师更善于应对变化，工作效率也往往更高。“他们工作起来更开心，职业发展也更加顺利。” 随着 AI 改变软件开发的工作方式，不少技术主管也开始重新思考什么样的工程师才算优秀。不少观点认为，当工程师的工作逐渐转向 管理 AI 智能体、作出更多决策时 ，技术品味和判断力就显得尤为重要。 IT之家从报道中获悉，亚马逊云科技首席工程师戴维 · 亚纳切克最近则提出，最优秀的开发者应该 既“多疑”又“懒惰” ：他们喜欢把重复劳动交给自动化工具完成，同时也足够谨慎，懂得设置必要的安全限制，让 AI 智能体无需时刻有人盯着，也能安全运行。
items.summary_en: According to a Business Insider report on the evening of November 12, Matt Wood, chief AI and technology officer at Amazon Web Services (AWS), believes truly excellent engineers should focus more on the problem to be solved than on one particular solution. He said he hopes engineers will not be overly attached to their specific proposals but put more passion into the problem itself; excellent engineers do not only use AI to write code but also use it to analyze problems in depth and try different approaches. In the past, software development was costly, so concentrating a team's resources on one solution was often more economical; with AI, developers can study a problem more thoroughly and try multiple solutions at the same time. Last month Amazon published a memo with new role guidance and proposed the concept of a 'Renaissance developer era'; the new guidance no longer emphasizes using AI as much as possible but places more value on the long-term value engineers can bring to customers and the business. Engineers used to spend days waiting for code review, manual testing and design changes; once AI can generate code, they can devote more energy to complex review work. Wood believes engineers who are not fixated on one solution are better at handling change and often more productive; they are happier at work and progress further in their careers. As AI changes software development, many tech leaders are rethinking what makes an excellent engineer; some argue that as engineers shift toward managing AI agents and making more decisions, technical taste and judgment become especially important. AWS principal engineer David Yanacek recently suggested that the best developers should be both 'paranoid' and 'lazy': they like to delegate repetitive work to automation tools, while being cautious enough to set necessary safety limits so AI agents can run safely without constant supervision.
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映AI编程工具普及后，工程能力评价可能更侧重问题定义、判断力与AI智能体管理，而非单纯写代码。
items.why_en: Speculative: this suggests that as AI coding tools spread, engineering evaluation may focus more on problem definition, judgment and AI-agent management rather than coding alone.

items.title_zh: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO 重创全球 AI 概念股，AMD、博通逆势上涨
items.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns, Hit Global AI Stocks; AMD and Broadcom Rise Against Trend
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，据路透社报道，黄仁勋因婚外情丑闻持续发酵而辞去英伟达 CEO，引发 全球 AI 概念股周四大跌 。 英伟达领导层突遭变动，也让原本就面临融资和监管压力的 AI 行业增添了新的风险。 英伟达宣布，CFO 科莱特 · 克雷斯将暂任 CEO，公司同时寻找正式接班人。 作为 AI 产业链的核心企业，英伟达不仅供应芯片，还为采用其芯片的数据中心等基础设施项目提供资金支持，这种商业模式因循环融资问题受到质疑。随着英伟达陷入更深的危机，整个 AI 行业也面临新的压力。 英伟达股价早盘下跌 8.2%，跌至 16 个多月以来的最低水平 ，市值更是 2025 年 7 月以来 首次跌破 4 万亿美元 。 英伟达投资的新型云计算服务商 CoreWeave 股价下跌 9.1% 。就在前一个交易日，CoreWeave 还因财报表现带动 AI 概念股反弹，单日涨幅超过 27%。 其他新型云计算服务商也未能幸免， IREN 和 Applied Digital 股价双双走低 。Nebius 则在宣布 2026 年营收将接近此前预测区间下限后，股价大跌 16.2%。 自英伟达董事会周日宣布调查黄仁勋的婚外情丑闻以来，公司市值蒸发 超过 5,500 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 3.68 万亿元人民币） 。 盈透证券首席市场分析师史蒂夫 · 索斯尼克指出：“英伟达与行业内众多企业之间存在盘根错节的交易关系。究竟让整个行业更加稳定，还是更加脆弱？随着事态在未来几周逐渐明朗，答案也会浮出水面。” 数据分析公司 ORTEX 的数据显示，仅本周以来， 做空英伟达的投资者就获得了 96 亿美元 （现汇率约合 641.84 亿元人民币） 的账面收益 。 芯片制造商一直被视为 AI 热潮的主要受益者，此次也成为 抛售潮的重灾区 ，费城半导体指数下跌 1.3%。 美满电子股价下跌 3.8%。黄仁勋今年 6 月曾点名美满电子，称其 有望成为“下一家万亿美元公司” 。 甲骨文也下跌 2.6%，公司正扩大与英伟达在云端 AI 芯片方面的合作。 其他科技股同样承压。 美光科技下跌 2.5%，闪迪和西部数据分别下跌 6% 和 3.7% 。光子器件制造商 Lumentum、Coherent，以及 AI 服务器制造商戴尔的跌幅在 3% 至 5.1% 之间。 建筑及发电设备制造商卡特彼勒和电力企业 Vistra 则 分别下跌约 0.5% 。 与英伟达竞争的另外两家 AI 芯片制造商 AMD 和博通逆势上涨，涨幅分别为 3.7% 和 5.6% 。投资者预期，英伟达陷入动荡可能为竞争对手创造机会。 Alphabet、亚马逊和微软等大型云服务商的股价也 上涨了 0.8% 至 2.7% 。 全球科技股市场同样出现震荡。 日本和韩国股市均收跌近 0.7%，欧洲科技股也下跌约 1% 。 伦敦证券交易所集团汇总的数据显示，英伟达目前的未来 12 个月预期市盈率约为 12 倍，降至 2012 年 11 月以来的最低水平。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 12, Reuters reported that Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO as an extramarital affair scandal continued to escalate, triggering a sharp drop in global AI-related stocks on Thursday. The sudden leadership change at Nvidia also added new risks to an AI industry already facing financing and regulatory pressure. Nvidia announced that CFO Colette Kress would serve as interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent successor. As a core company in the AI supply chain, Nvidia not only supplies chips but also provides funding for infrastructure projects such as data centers that use its chips; this business model has been questioned over circular financing. As Nvidia falls deeper into crisis, the entire AI industry also faces new pressure. Nvidia shares fell 8.2% in early trading to their lowest level in more than 16 months, and its market capitalization fell below $4 trillion for the first time since July 2025. CoreWeave, a new cloud computing provider backed by Nvidia, fell 9.1%; in the previous trading session, CoreWeave had helped AI-related stocks rebound on its financial results, rising more than 27% in one day. Other new cloud providers did not escape: IREN and Applied Digital both fell; Nebius plunged 16.2% after announcing that 2026 revenue would be near the lower end of its previous forecast range. Since Nvidia's board announced an investigation into Huang's extramarital affair scandal on Sunday, the company's market value has evaporated by more than $550 billion (original note: about RMB 3.68 trillion at current exchange rates). Steve Sosnick, chief market analyst at Interactive Brokers, said: 'Nvidia has intricate trading relationships with many companies in the industry. Does that make the whole industry more stable or more fragile? As the situation becomes clearer in the coming weeks, the answer will emerge.' Data from analytics firm ORTEX showed that investors shorting Nvidia have gained $9.6 billion (original note: about RMB 64.184 billion at current exchange rates) in paper profits this week alone. Chipmakers have long been seen as major beneficiaries of the AI boom and this time also bore the brunt of the selloff; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 1.3%. Marvell fell 3.8%; Huang named Marvell in June this year and said it had the potential to become the 'next trillion-dollar company.' Oracle also fell 2.6%; the company is expanding cooperation with Nvidia on cloud AI chips. Other tech stocks also came under pressure: Micron fell 2.5%, SanDisk and Western Digital fell 6% and 3.7% respectively; optical device makers Lumentum and Coherent and AI server maker Dell fell between 3% and 5.1%; construction and power equipment maker Caterpillar and utility Vistra fell about 0.5% each. AMD and Broadcom, two other AI chipmakers competing with Nvidia, rose against the trend by 3.7% and 5.6% respectively, as investors expected Nvidia's turmoil might create opportunities for rivals. Shares of large cloud providers Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft also rose 0.8% to 2.7%. Global tech stock markets also fluctuated: Japanese and South Korean markets both closed down nearly 0.7%, and European tech stocks fell about 1%. Data compiled by London Stock Exchange Group showed that Nvidia's current forward 12-month price-to-earnings ratio is about 12 times, the lowest since November 2012.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，据路透社报道，黄仁勋因婚外情丑闻持续发酵而辞去英伟达 CEO，引发 全球 AI 概念股周四大跌 。 英伟达领导层突遭变动，也让原本就面临融资和监管压力的 AI 行业增添了新的风险。 英伟达宣布，CFO 科莱特 · 克雷斯将暂任 CEO，公司同时寻找正式接班人。 作为 AI 产业链的核心企业，英伟达不仅供应芯片，还为采用其芯片的数据中心等基础设施项目提供资金支持，这种商业模式因循环融资问题受到质疑。随着英伟达陷入更深的危机，整个 AI 行业也面临新的压力。 英伟达股价早盘下跌 8.2%，跌至 16 个多月以来的最低水平 ，市值更是 2025 年 7 月以来 首次跌破 4 万亿美元 。 英伟达投资的新型云计算服务商 CoreWeave 股价下跌 9.1% 。就在前一个交易日，CoreWeave 还因财报表现带动 AI 概念股反弹，单日涨幅超过 27%。 其他新型云计算服务商也未能幸免， IREN 和 Applied Digital 股价双双走低 。Nebius 则在宣布 2026 年营收将接近此前预测区间下限后，股价大跌 16.2%。 自英伟达董事会周日宣布调查黄仁勋的婚外情丑闻以来，公司市值蒸发 超过 5,500 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 3.68 万亿元人民币） 。 盈透证券首席市场分析师史蒂夫 · 索斯尼克指出：“英伟达与行业内众多企业之间存在盘根错节的交易关系。究竟让整个行业更加稳定，还是更加脆弱？随着事态在未来几周逐渐明朗，答案也会浮出水面。” 数据分析公司 ORTEX 的数据显示，仅本周以来， 做空英伟达的投资者就获得了 96 亿美元 （现汇率约合 641.84 亿元人民币） 的账面收益 。 芯片制造商一直被视为 AI 热潮的主要受益者，此次也成为 抛售潮的重灾区 ，费城半导体指数下跌 1.3%。 美满电子股价下跌 3.8%。黄仁勋今年 6 月曾点名美满电子，称其 有望成为“下一家万亿美元公司” 。 甲骨文也下跌 2.6%，公司正扩大与英伟达在云端 AI 芯片方面的合作。 其他科技股同样承压。 美光科技下跌 2.5%，闪迪和西部数据分别下跌 6% 和 3.7% 。光子器件制造商 Lumentum、Coherent，以及 AI 服务器制造商戴尔的跌幅在 3% 至 5.1% 之间。 建筑及发电设备制造商卡特彼勒和电力企业 Vistra 则 分别下跌约 0.5% 。 与英伟达竞争的另外两家 AI 芯片制造商 AMD 和博通逆势上涨，涨幅分别为 3.7% 和 5.6% 。投资者预期，英伟达陷入动荡可能为竞争对手创造机会。 Alphabet、亚马逊和微软等大型云服务商的股价也 上涨了 0.8% 至 2.7% 。 全球科技股市场同样出现震荡。 日本和韩国股市均收跌近 0.7%，欧洲科技股也下跌约 1% 。 伦敦证券交易所集团汇总的数据显示，英伟达目前的未来 12 个月预期市盈率约为 12 倍，降至 2012 年 11 月以来的最低水平。

items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 12, GAC announced that its Aion Ray 7 is now officially launched. It is the first mid-to-large all-electric sedan in the Ray series, nearly 5 meters long, with a low, wide body design, a drag coefficient as low as 0.22Cd, aimed at the youth market, priced from RMB 123,800, with a limited-time launch price from RMB 114,700. The prices listed in the original article are: 702 rear-wheel-drive Driving Fun CATL version at RMB 133,800, limited-time RMB 124,700; 702 rear-wheel-drive LiDAR CATL version at RMB 143,800, RMB 134,700; 702 rear-wheel-drive EMB LiDAR CATL version at RMB 153,800, RMB 144,700; 530 rear-wheel-drive Driving Fun version at RMB 123,800, RMB 114,700; 530 rear-wheel-drive LiDAR version at RMB 133,800, RMB 124,700. The original article also lists multiple purchase benefits: a RMB 1,000 deposit expands to RMB 2,000 toward the car; a limited-time RMB 3,000 early-adopter subsidy; a RMB 5,000 trade-in subsidy regardless of brand; up to RMB 6,000 in finance interest subsidy, including a RMB 100,000 two-year 0-interest plan and a five-year RMB 100,000 plan with the first two years at 0 interest; a limited-time free Midsummer Purple custom paint worth RMB 3,999, or a RMB 1,999 option for Lightning Yellow custom paint worth RMB 5,999; limited-time free integrated sport seats worth RMB 3,999; limited-time savings of up to RMB 3,999 on a high-performance package option; a limited-time free three-layer silver-plated panoramic roof worth RMB 4,999; a limited-time free upgrade to a 17-speaker audio system worth RMB 5,000; 5,000 points for repeat buyers who previously owned a GAC brand vehicle; 1,000 points as a red packet upon ordering, and up to 10,000 points in subsidies for delayed waiting; lifetime warranty on the three electric components for the first owner, and a 4-year/150,000 km vehicle warranty; a limited-time free 5m connected charging pile worth RMB 4,999; lifetime free basic data, and free entertainment data of 6G per month for the first year. The car is offered in Lightning Yellow and Midsummer Purple body colors. The front face adopts the family-style 'Quantum Star Ring' design, with a continuous light strip and an illuminated brand logo; the lower bumper has large air intakes, with flow-guiding ventilation structures on both sides; the side has semi-hidden door handles, and the rear uses a continuous taillight group. The cockpit features a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8295P cockpit chip, 24GB LPDDR4 RAM, 128GB UFS flash storage, a 15.6-inch 2.5K high-definition central control screen, and full phone-car connectivity. For advanced driver assistance, the Ray 7 is equipped with 27 automotive-grade full-view sensors, including a Huawei 192-line LiDAR and three 4D millimeter-wave radars, and carries a large model derived from WeRide's L4 Robotaxi. In terms of specifications, the car measures 4,960×1,900×1,455 mm with a wheelbase of 2,920 mm; it features 'super three electrics,' a HUAWEI DriveONE multi-in-one electric drive, and Aion's new thermal management system and 28-in-1 thermal management module, with CLTC energy consumption of 9.7 kWh per 100 km and CLTC pure electric range of 700 km; it uses CATL batteries and integrates Aion's Magazine Battery 2.0 technology.

items.title_zh: OpenAI CEO 奥尔特曼现身超跑聚会，身旁停着数百万美元柯尼塞格
items.title_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Spotted at Supercar Meet Beside Multimillion-Dollar Koenigsegg
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）不仅是硅谷科技圈的风云人物，也是一位不折不扣的汽车发烧友。 上周日，一名 TikTok 用户发布了一段视频，展示了一场颇为壮观的跑车聚会。视频中，大量跑车和豪华超跑停在一条蜿蜒的公路旁，车型从福特 Mustang、讴歌 NSX，到帕加尼 Utopia 和柯尼塞格 Regera。 而就在一辆银色雷克萨斯 LFA 旁边，站着一位意想不到的人物：OpenAI CEO 萨姆 · 奥尔特曼。 据视频发布者米格尔 · 戈迪内斯（Miguel Godinez）向 Business Insider 透露，这场聚会完全是偶然发生的。 当天，他和另外 8 名朋友驾驶各自的跑车，前往加利福尼亚州纳帕东北部、贝里耶萨湖（Lake Berryessa）附近的峡谷兜风。途中，他们在一家加油站停车休息，随后发现一批此前从未见过的跑车陆续出现。 戈迪内斯主要在自己的社交账号上分享跑车相关内容。他谈到奥尔特曼时表示：“我们聊了一会儿，他人特别友善，也很随和。我觉得他就像一个普通人，开着自己的车，和我们一样有着相同的爱好。” 这并不是奥尔特曼第一次被拍到与柯尼塞格 Regera 同框，这款超跑售价最高可达 460 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 3,075.5 万元人民币） 。 2024 年 4 月，就有人在加利福尼亚州纳帕市区拍到一辆 Regera 行驶在街道上。几个月后，当拍摄者放大驾驶座区域时，才发现坐在方向盘后面的竟然是奥尔特曼。 戈迪内斯表示，他无法确定奥尔特曼当天究竟驾驶的是哪一款超跑。不过，此次聚会中出现的 Regera 与 2024 年被拍到的那辆颜色相同。值得一提的是，柯尼塞格全球仅生产了 80 辆 Regera。 当然，也不排除奥尔特曼驾驶的是帕加尼 Utopia。这款车型同样极为稀有，全球产量约为 260 辆。 无论他当天开的是哪一辆，都可以肯定不是普通的代步车。 而从视频中奥尔特曼驻足欣赏雷克萨斯 LFA 的神情来看，即便是硅谷最顶尖的科技富豪，面对真正令人心动的跑车时，也难免会露出车迷般的惊喜。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 12, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is not only a prominent figure in Silicon Valley tech circles but also a car enthusiast. Last Sunday, a TikTok user posted a video showing a spectacular sports car gathering: many sports cars and luxury supercars were parked along a winding road, with models ranging from a Ford Mustang and Acura NSX to a Pagani Utopia and Koenigsegg Regera. Next to a silver Lexus LFA stood Altman. Video poster Miguel Godinez told Business Insider that the gathering happened entirely by chance: that day he and eight other friends were driving their sports cars to a canyon near Lake Berryessa, northeast of Napa, California; they stopped at a gas station to rest and then saw a group of previously unseen sports cars gradually appear. Godinez mainly shares sports car content on his social account. Speaking of Altman, he said: 'We chatted for a while; he was very friendly and easygoing. I think he is like an ordinary person, driving his own car and sharing the same hobby as us.' This is not the first time Altman has been photographed with a Koenigsegg Regera; this supercar can cost up to $4.6 million (original note: about RMB 30.755 million at current exchange rates). In April 2024, someone filmed a Regera driving on a street in Napa, California; months later, when the photographer zoomed into the driver's seat area, he discovered that Altman was behind the wheel. Godinez said he could not confirm which supercar Altman was driving that day; however, the Regera at the gathering was the same color as the one filmed in 2024. Koenigsegg produced only 80 Regeras worldwide. The original article also noted that it cannot be ruled out that Altman was driving a Pagani Utopia, of which about 260 units are produced worldwide. Whichever one he was driving that day, it was certainly not an ordinary commuter car. From Altman's expression as he stopped to admire the Lexus LFA in the video, even the top tech billionaire in Silicon Valley cannot help showing a car fan's delight when facing a truly exciting sports car.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）不仅是硅谷科技圈的风云人物，也是一位不折不扣的汽车发烧友。 上周日，一名 TikTok 用户发布了一段视频，展示了一场颇为壮观的跑车聚会。视频中，大量跑车和豪华超跑停在一条蜿蜒的公路旁，车型从福特 Mustang、讴歌 NSX，到帕加尼 Utopia 和柯尼塞格 Regera。 而就在一辆银色雷克萨斯 LFA 旁边，站着一位意想不到的人物：OpenAI CEO 萨姆 · 奥尔特曼。 据视频发布者米格尔 · 戈迪内斯（Miguel Godinez）向 Business Insider 透露，这场聚会完全是偶然发生的。 当天，他和另外 8 名朋友驾驶各自的跑车，前往加利福尼亚州纳帕东北部、贝里耶萨湖（Lake Berryessa）附近的峡谷兜风。途中，他们在一家加油站停车休息，随后发现一批此前从未见过的跑车陆续出现。 戈迪内斯主要在自己的社交账号上分享跑车相关内容。他谈到奥尔特曼时表示：“我们聊了一会儿，他人特别友善，也很随和。我觉得他就像一个普通人，开着自己的车，和我们一样有着相同的爱好。” 这并不是奥尔特曼第一次被拍到与柯尼塞格 Regera 同框，这款超跑售价最高可达 460 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 3,075.5 万元人民币） 。 2024 年 4 月，就有人在加利福尼亚州纳帕市区拍到一辆 Regera 行驶在街道上。几个月后，当拍摄者放大驾驶座区域时，才发现坐在方向盘后面的竟然是奥尔特曼。 戈迪内斯表示，他无法确定奥尔特曼当天究竟驾驶的是哪一款超跑。不过，此次聚会中出现的 Regera 与 2024 年被拍到的那辆颜色相同。值得一提的是，柯尼塞格全球仅生产了 80 辆 Regera。 当然，也不排除奥尔特曼驾驶的是帕加尼 Utopia。这款车型同样极为稀有，全球产量约为 260 辆。 无论他当天开的是哪一辆，都可以肯定不是普通的代步车。 而从视频中奥尔特曼驻足欣赏雷克萨斯 LFA 的神情来看，即便是硅谷最顶尖的科技富豪，面对真正令人心动的跑车时，也难免会露出车迷般的惊喜。

items.title_zh: 月之暗面徐天天：AI 迭代速度将继续加快
items.title_en: Moonshot AI's Xu Tiantian: AI Iteration Will Keep Accelerating
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，据新浪财经报道，在今日“以发展应变局”为主题的第十七届财新峰会上，月之暗面金融行业与生态负责人徐天天发表讲话。 针对“AI 迭代速度是否还会加快”问题，徐天天表示， 当前整个 AI 智能远远未达到上限 。 她指出，这背后有三条增长曲线：其一，预训练算力曲线；其二，后训练与推理端曲线，AI 已从快思考转变为慢思考，展现思考链路；其三，智能体设计曲线，智能体设计越来越复杂，将导致智能上限提高。这三条曲线都在增长，三者叠加， 导致 AI 迭代速度加快 。 IT之家注意到，徐天天指出，AI 智能体独自能完成的任务时长还在增长，也正在加速。这意味着， AI 从最初的“打杂”工作，转变为切入更深的工作流程中 。 相关阅读： 《 月之暗面 2.8 万亿参数 Kimi K3.1 Pro 开放权重，登顶 Agent Arena 开源模型榜 》
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 12, Sina Finance reported that Xu Tiantian, head of financial industry and ecosystem at Moonshot AI, spoke at the 17th Caixin Summit themed 'Responding to Change Through Development' that day. Asked whether AI iteration will continue to accelerate, Xu said current AI intelligence is far from its upper limit. She pointed to three growth curves: first, the pretraining compute curve; second, the post-training and inference curve, as AI has moved from fast thinking to slow thinking and shows reasoning chains; third, the agent design curve, as agent designs become more complex and raise the intelligence ceiling. All three curves are growing, and their combination is accelerating AI iteration. Xu also noted that the duration of tasks AI agents can complete on their own is still growing and accelerating; this means AI is moving from initial 'odd jobs' into deeper workflows. A related reading cited in the original article said Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3.1 Pro opened its weights and topped the Agent Arena open-source model leaderboard.
items.why_zh: 推测：若预训练、后训练与智能体设计三条曲线叠加，AI能力评估与行业应用节奏可能继续加快。
items.why_en: Speculative: if the pretraining, post-training and agent-design curves combine, AI capability evaluation and industry adoption may continue to accelerate.

items.title_zh: 科大讯飞星火语音基座大模型 SparkAudio 1.0 上线 API 服务，支持 99 种语言、202 种方言
items.title_en: iFlytek's SparkAudio 1.0 speech foundation model launches API service, supporting 99 languages and 202 dialects
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，科大讯飞今日宣布，讯飞星火语音基座大模型 SparkAudio 1.0 已在讯飞开放平台上线 API 服务， 开发者可直接接入调用 。 SparkAudio 1.0 支持文本和语音两个模态的输入以及文本模态的输出，可支持语音转写、多语言翻译、多方言识别、环境音理解、说话人分离、情感分析以及复杂的音频问答等场景任务的实现。 官方表示，过去处理音频大多采用级联方案：先把语音转成文字，再交给大模型理解。这种做法有两个明显短板： 信息丢失：文字只能记录说了什么，会丢掉语音里自带的语气、情绪，还有背景环境音等关键信息，导致模型对场景的判断不完整，自然也会影响到最后的结果。 链路割裂：这套系统把语音转写、声纹识别、语音翻译等能力拆成独立模块串联运行，模块之间存在断点，不仅容易累积错误，在使用体验上也会出现延迟、卡顿。 据介绍，语音基座大模型解决了上面的这些问题：它不再只做语音转文字，而是直接理解语音。语音基座大模型一次性听懂人声、环境音、音乐等等，而且还能理解声音里的语义、情绪和场景。 相较于上一代模型，星火语音基座 SparkAudio 1.0 在三大方面有了全新升级： 听见更多： 支持 99 种语言、202 种方言 ，能够处理多语言语音识别与翻译任务； 理解更透： 从语音识别到多维音频理解 ，能理解语音的深层含义，支持智能客服、汽车座舱、跨语会议、医疗病历、内容审核等多种场景； 用得更广： 全国产算力训练 ，为开发者和行业应用提供自主可控的语音智能底座。 IT之家附相关链接： 体验链接： https://iflytekresearch.iflytek.com/console/spark-audio API 地址： https://www.xfyun.cn/services/Spark_Audio_1.0 相关阅读： 《 科大讯飞首发星火语音基座大模型 SparkAudio 1.0：中英文任意切换、说话人实时识别，输入法里就能用 》
items.summary_en: iFlytek announced that its SparkAudio 1.0 speech foundation model has launched an API service on the iFlytek Open Platform, which developers can call directly. SparkAudio 1.0 supports text and speech inputs and text output, and can be used for tasks such as speech transcription, multilingual translation, multi-dialect recognition, environmental sound understanding, speaker separation, sentiment analysis and complex audio question answering. The company said audio processing has mostly used cascaded pipelines: first converting speech to text, then handing it to a large model to understand. This has two clear shortcomings: information loss (text records only what was said, losing tone, emotion and background sounds, which makes the model's judgment of the scene incomplete and affects results) and fragmented pipelines (transcription, voiceprint recognition and speech translation are split into separate modules run in series, with breaks between modules that accumulate errors and cause latency and stutter in use). The speech foundation model, by contrast, no longer only converts speech to text but directly understands speech, taking in voices, environmental sounds and music at once and understanding semantics, emotion and scene. Compared with the previous generation, SparkAudio 1.0 brings three upgrades: support for 99 languages and 202 dialects; a shift from speech recognition to multi-dimensional audio understanding, supporting smart customer service, car cockpits, cross-language meetings, medical records and content moderation; and training on fully domestic compute. The article includes a demo link and API address.
items.why_zh: 若其宣称的多语言、多方言与音频理解能力在实际调用中成立，此类语音基座模型开放 API 可能降低开发者构建语音应用的接入门槛（推测）。
items.why_en: If its claimed multilingual, multi-dialect and audio-understanding capabilities hold in practice, opening such a speech foundation model via API could lower the barrier for developers building voice applications (speculative).

items.title_en: Anthropic reportedly adds limits to Claude, blocking generation of Pokémon-related game assets
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，随着 AI 被广泛用于生成艺术作品、视频乃至电子游戏素材，相关技术的发展速度已经超过了版权限制措施的完善速度。如今，游戏行业也开始采取行动。最新迹象显示，Claude 的开发商 Anthropic 已经为其大语言模型加入限制，禁止用户利用宝可梦（Pokémon）相关知识产权生成游戏素材。 IT之家注意到，这一发现最初来自日本媒体 Automaton 收集的用户反馈。多名用户发现，当他们尝试使用 Claude 开发受宝可梦启发的粉丝自制游戏时，Claude 会直接拒绝提供帮助。 一名名为 Big Kid Nation 的用户似乎正在借助 AI 开发一款非官方宝可梦游戏。他分享的截图显示，当用户要求 Claude 使用明显属于宝可梦角色的精灵图（Sprite）生成游戏素材时，Claude 拒绝了这一请求。 用户随后进一步询问，如果这些素材已经保存在自己的电脑上，是否会改变 Claude 的处理方式。Claude 给出的答案仍然是否定的，并表示不会使用任何看起来与宝可梦知识产权相似的内容来生成素材。 Claude 不仅限制角色，还涉及音乐、关卡和名称 X 用户 chasm 对 Claude 的代码进行了进一步分析，似乎找到了模型目前明确限制使用的宝可梦相关内容。 限制范围包括音乐、舞台和关卡、角色外观、名称以及角色本身。此前 Big Kid Nation 遇到的精灵图生成请求遭到拒绝，很可能同时触及了角色和外观这两类限制。 Claude 不愿协助用户利用 AI 制作宝可梦游戏，似乎是此前一项版权保护更新的延伸。 此前，越来越多人开始使用 AI 复制其他开发者的电子游戏，甚至有人在原版游戏尚未正式发售时，就尝试利用 AI 生成类似作品。这种现象正逐渐演变成一个值得关注的问题。 Anthropic 此前已经更新 Claude，试图阻止用户利用模型复制现有电子游戏，并将生成的作品冒充为自己的原创成果。相关更新采用了较为宽泛的限制措施，旨在覆盖整个电子游戏行业。 不过，此前的限制主要针对电子游戏内容的整体复制，而此次拒绝生成宝可梦相关素材，则是目前已知 Claude 首次针对某个具体游戏系列作出明确限制。 Anthropic 选择从宝可梦开始采取这类措施并不令人意外。一方面，宝可梦可能是 Claude 用户最经常要求模型模仿的游戏系列之一；另一方面，如果允许用户利用 AI 生成包含宝可梦角色、音乐和其他受版权保护元素的内容，甚至制作完整的非官方宝可梦游戏，Anthropic 也可能面临相当大的法律风险。 一旦宝可梦公司（The Pokémon Company）和任天堂（Nintendo）认为事态已经超出可接受范围，并决定对 Claude 的开发商采取法律行动，相关纠纷可能会变得十分棘手。 目前，这些限制措施反映出 AI 厂商正在尝试为生成式 AI 划定版权边界。随着 AI 制作游戏素材和完整游戏的门槛不断降低，如何防止模型直接复制现有游戏 IP，也将成为整个游戏行业无法回避的问题。
items.summary_en: As AI is widely used to generate artwork, video and even video game assets, the technology is outpacing copyright safeguards, and the game industry is starting to act. The latest sign: Claude developer Anthropic has added restrictions to its large language model barring users from generating game assets based on Pokémon intellectual property. The finding initially came from user reports collected by Japanese outlet Automaton: multiple users found that when they tried to use Claude to develop Pokémon-inspired fan games, Claude refused to help. Screenshots shared by a user named Big Kid Nation show Claude refusing a request to generate game assets using sprites clearly belonging to Pokémon characters; when the user asked whether it would change anything if those assets were already saved on their own computer, Claude still said no, stating it would not generate assets using anything that looks similar to Pokémon IP. X user chasm analyzed Claude's code further and said they found the Pokémon-related content the model explicitly restricts, covering music, stages and levels, character appearance, names and the characters themselves. Claude's reluctance to help users make Pokémon games with AI appears to be an extension of an earlier copyright-protection update: after more people began using AI to replicate other developers' video games, sometimes before the original game's official release, Anthropic updated Claude to stop users from copying existing games and passing the results off as their own, using broad restrictions meant to cover the whole video game industry. That earlier restriction mainly targeted wholesale copying of game content, whereas the refusal to generate Pokémon assets is the first known case of Claude explicitly restricting a specific game franchise. The report says starting with Pokémon is unsurprising: Pokémon may be one of the franchises Claude users most often ask the model to imitate, and allowing AI-generated content with Pokémon characters, music and other copyrighted elements — or even complete unofficial Pokémon games — could expose Anthropic to considerable legal risk. The restrictions reflect AI vendors' attempts to draw copyright boundaries for generative AI.
items.why_zh: 这些限制源自用户反馈与代码分析，尚未见 Anthropic 官方说明；若属实，则表明 AI 厂商正针对具体游戏 IP 划定版权边界（推测）。
items.why_en: The restrictions come from user reports and code analysis, with no official Anthropic statement seen; if accurate, they suggest AI vendors are drawing copyright boundaries around specific game IP (speculative).

items.title_zh: 摩根大通：到 2030 年，美国人形机器人产量将达 30 万至 40 万台
items.title_en: JPMorgan: US humanoid robot output to reach 300,000–400,000 units by 2030
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，据路透社今天（12 日）报道，摩根大通最新预测显示，随着人形机器人从技术展示走向商业化应用，美国人形机器人产量 到 2030 年将达到 30 万至 40 万台 ，2035 年进一步增至约 150 万台。 劳动力短缺、使用成本下降和产能扩大，正推动制造、物流和仓储企业采用人形机器人，以替代重复性人工劳动。 不过，人形机器人的大规模应用仍面临 硬件、AI 训练数据、算力和产能 等方面的限制。除特斯拉外，美国大多数厂商的年产量目标 仅为 1 万至 3 万台 。 摩根大通估计，人形机器人的使用成本已逐渐接近人工成本。如果安排机器人多班次作业，每家客户每年可节省约 10 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 66.9 万元人民币） 。然而在短期内，行业发展仍受制于供应能力。 灵巧手、执行器、机器人“大脑”和产能 是几大主要瓶颈。 相比整机制造商，摩根大通认为零部件供应商在短期内更具投资机会，预计到 2035 年，执行器、电机、视觉系统等核心零部件的市场规模将 接近 300 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,005.74 亿元人民币） 。 整机厂商方面，摩根大通重点提及特斯拉的 Optimus、Agility Robotics 的 Digit、波士顿动力的 Atlas、Figure AI 的 Figure 系列机器人，以及 Apptronik 的 Apollo，认为这些产品背后的企业是美国人形机器人行业的主要参与者。 零部件供应商方面，摩根大通看好铁姆肯、ROBOTIS、绿的谐波、奥比中光和康耐视。
items.summary_en: Citing Reuters, JPMorgan's latest forecast says that as humanoid robots move from technology demonstrations toward commercial deployment, US humanoid robot output will reach 300,000 to 400,000 units by 2030 and rise further to about 1.5 million units by 2035. Labor shortages, falling usage costs and expanding capacity are pushing manufacturing, logistics and warehousing companies to adopt humanoid robots to replace repetitive manual work. However, large-scale adoption still faces constraints in hardware, AI training data, compute and production capacity. Apart from Tesla, most US vendors have annual output targets of only 10,000 to 30,000 units. JPMorgan estimates that humanoid robot usage costs are gradually approaching human labor costs; if robots work multiple shifts, each customer could save about $100,000 per year (about 669,000 yuan at current exchange rates). In the near term, the industry remains constrained by supply capability, with dexterous hands, actuators, the robot "brain" and production capacity as the main bottlenecks. Compared with complete-robot makers, JPMorgan sees more near-term investment opportunity among component suppliers, and expects the market for core components such as actuators, motors and vision systems to approach $30 billion by 2035 (about 200.574 billion yuan at current exchange rates). On complete robots, JPMorgan highlights Tesla's Optimus, Agility Robotics' Digit, Boston Dynamics' Atlas, Figure AI's Figure series and Apptronik's Apollo as the main players in the US humanoid robot industry. Among component suppliers it favors Timken, ROBOTIS, Leaderdrive, Orbbec and Cognex.
items.why_zh: 该预测给出了人形机器人量产的量化路径，但产量与成本目标仍取决于尚未解决的硬件、数据与产能瓶颈（推测）。
items.why_en: The forecast sketches a quantified path to humanoid robot mass production, but output and cost targets still depend on unresolved hardware, data and capacity bottlenecks (speculative).

items.why_zh: 若代理式 AI 被挡在交易环节之外，可能限制其在旅行等受监管行业的实际落地空间（推测）。

items.title_zh: AMD 发布肾上腺素 26.11.1 可选驱动：修复 SSD 异常写入问题，公布多项已知游戏兼容问题
items.title_en: AMD Releases Adrenalin 26.11.1 Optional Driver: Fixes Abnormal SSD Writes and Lists Known Game Compatibility Issues
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.11.1 可选版（Optional）显卡驱动现已发布，本次更新重点修复了此前广受关注的系统盘异常写入问题，同时公布了多项游戏与平台兼容方面的已知问题及临时解决方案。 问题修复 修复 Radeon RX 7000 系列及以上显卡在系统空闲时， 持续对系统盘进行异常写入 的问题；该问题此前被报道写入速率可达 0.3MB/s 至 5MB/s，单日累计写入量最高超 400GB，可能影响 SSD 寿命。 修复移动或调整应用窗口大小时，触发系统盘异常写入的问题。 已知问题与临时方案 在 Radeon RX 7000 系列显卡上游玩《刺客信条：黑旗重制版》时，可能间歇性出现应用崩溃或驱动超时； 在 Radeon RX 5000 系列显卡上游玩《战争雷霆》时可能间歇性出现驱动超时，遇到该问题的用户建议回退至 AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.9.1； 部分 Radeon RX 9000 系列显卡在副显示器播放视频时，若同时开启 AMD FSR 超分辨率、Radeon Anti-Lag 以及《赛博朋克 2077》游戏内帧生成功能，可能间歇性出现应用崩溃或驱动超时，建议关闭游戏内帧生成； 搭载锐龙 AI Max PRO 400 系列处理器的设备在游玩《使命召唤：现代战争重制版》时，使用 Alt+Tab 切换窗口可能导致游戏无响应； 搭载锐龙 AI 9 400 系列处理器的设备启动《战争机器：重制版》时可能出现黑屏，建议先将游戏显示模式切换为窗口化，再切回全屏； 部分无法正常访问 HuggingFace 与 GitHub 的区域，安装 AI Bundle 组件时可能失败； Windows 10 系统安装驱动后，AMD Smart Access Memory 功能可能被自动禁用； Radeon RX 9000 系列显卡游玩《影之刃：零》时，角色头发部位可能出现画面异常，建议关闭游戏内的高品质头发特效； Radeon RX 9000 系列显卡游玩《使命召唤：现代战争重制版》时，可能出现黑色画面损坏。 该驱动为可选版本，面向 Radeon 系列独立显卡及锐龙 AI 系列核显平台，支持 Windows 10 64 位 1809 及以上版本与 Windows 11 系统。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 13, AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.11.1 optional graphics driver has been released. The update focuses on fixing abnormal continuous writes to the system disk by Radeon RX 7000 series and newer GPUs when the system is idle (previous reports said write rates could reach 0.3MB/s to 5MB/s, with daily cumulative writes exceeding 400GB, potentially affecting SSD lifespan), and fixes abnormal system disk writes triggered when moving or resizing application windows. The driver also lists known issues and workarounds: RX 7000 series may intermittently crash or experience driver timeouts in Assassin's Creed Black Flag Remake; RX 5000 series may intermittently experience driver timeouts in War Thunder, and affected users are advised to roll back to 26.9.1; some RX 9000 series GPUs may intermittently crash or experience driver timeouts when playing video on a secondary display while enabling FSR, Radeon Anti-Lag and in-game frame generation in Cyberpunk 2077, and disabling in-game frame generation is advised; Ryzen AI Max PRO 400 devices may become unresponsive in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered when using Alt+Tab; Ryzen AI 9 400 devices may show a black screen when launching Gears of War: Remastered, and switching to windowed mode first and then back to full screen is advised; installing AI Bundle components may fail in some regions unable to normally access HuggingFace and GitHub; after installing the driver on Windows 10, AMD Smart Access Memory may be automatically disabled; RX 9000 series GPUs may show visual artifacts on character hair in Phantom Blade Zero, and disabling high-quality hair effects is advised; RX 9000 series GPUs may show black screen corruption in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. The driver is an optional version for Radeon discrete GPUs and Ryzen AI integrated graphics platforms, supporting Windows 10 64-bit 1809 and above and Windows 11.
items.why_zh: 推测：若修复有效，可缓解SSD寿命担忧；已知问题清单显示兼容性风险仍在。
items.why_en: Speculative: if the fix works, it may ease SSD lifespan concerns, while the known-issues list suggests compatibility risks remain.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，今天晚间的腾势 N8 上市发布会伊始，比亚迪腾势汽车总经理李慧就谈到了“速成车”。 李慧直言，今年的车市非常热闹，前 10 个月 平均每天有 3 场发布会 。热闹之下，行业内诞生了一个扎心的词 ——“速成车”。“速成车”压缩的是消费者 看不见、摸不着，但又关乎安全底线 的验证环节。这种走捷径的方式，是把用户当成免费的试车员。 他透露，腾势 N8 于 2023 年 8 月正式立项，至今打磨了 整整三年多 ，完成了冬测、夏测等大量安全类测试，一个都没有省，直到全部通过。腾势 N8 的测试数据是真实数据， 绝不是 AI 生成 。“在腾势造车体系中，安全是底线。 我们宁愿慢一点，也绝不在安全上抄近路 。…… 千锤百炼，只为让用户买车不烧心。” 发布会上，李慧还引用了百年药店“同仁堂”的古训： 炮制虽繁必不敢省人工，品味虽贵必不敢减物力 。 据IT之家了解，腾势 N8 共推出 6 款配置车型，官方指导价区间为 26.99 万-32.99 万元。新车先期仅提供纯电动版本，插电混动车型后续推出。 相关阅读： 《 比亚迪腾势 N8 正式上市：搭载 30 英寸全景屏 + 天际屏，售 26.99 万元起 》
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 12, at the start of the Denza N8 launch event, Li Hui, general manager of BYD's Denza Auto, discussed 'rushed cars.' He said this year's auto market has been very busy, with an average of three launch events per day in the first 10 months; the industry coined the term 'rushed cars,' which compresses validation steps that consumers cannot see or touch but that concern the safety bottom line, and this shortcut treats users as free test drivers. Li said the Denza N8 was officially initiated in August 2023 and has been refined for more than three years, completing extensive safety tests including winter and summer testing, with none omitted until all passed; the test data is real and absolutely not AI-generated. He said safety is the bottom line in Denza's vehicle-building system, 'we would rather go slower than cut corners on safety,' and cited Tongrentang's old motto. The Denza N8 has six configurations priced at RMB 269,900–329,900; it initially offers only a pure electric version, with a plug-in hybrid to follow.
items.why_zh: 推测：在价格战和新车密集发布背景下，高管强调安全验证，可能意在回应公众对“速成车”的担忧。
items.why_en: Speculative: amid price competition and密集 new-model launches, the executive's emphasis on safety validation may be intended to address public concerns about 'rushed cars.'

items.title_en: After Jensen Huang Resigns as CEO, NVIDIA's First Board Chair Harvey Jones Issues Internal Memo
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，黄仁勋辞去英伟达总裁、首席执行官及董事会成员职务后，成为英伟达首任董事会主席的哈维 · 琼斯（Harvey Jones）向英伟达员工发布内部备忘录。 琼斯拥有超过 30 年的创业、科技企业管理和风险投资经验，曾任新思科技 CEO 及执行董事长。 路透社获得了备忘录的副本，IT之家附译文如下： 各位英伟达员工： 我写信是想向大家通报一项重要决定。黄仁勋已辞去首席执行官及董事会成员职务，董事会已委任首席财务官（CFO）科莱特 · 克雷斯（Colette Kress）出任临时首席执行官；与此同时，董事会将面向内外部候选人遴选常任继任者。 我将出任公司有史以来的首任董事会主席 。 在担任首席财务官的 13 年多时间里，科莱特一直是英伟达业务增长与资本战略的关键缔造者之一。她对公司业务及所处市场有着极为深刻的理解。 董事会对科莱特充满信心，相信她能够带领公司履行对股东、客户、合作伙伴以及每一位员工的承诺 。 黄仁勋为英伟达作出了深远贡献 。英伟达是全球最具影响力的科技企业之一。我们开创了加速计算，定义了现代 GPU，并打造了驱动人工智能发展的核心平台。 董事会深感责任重大，定当恪尽职守，守护好这家伟大的企业 。 英伟达的力量源泉在于全体员工、领导团队、技术实力以及合作伙伴生态系统。我坚信，在科莱特的领导和董事会的全力支持下，公司业务将持续增长，并继续引领行业前行。感谢大家的专注投入、专业精神以及对英伟达的坚定奉献。 哈维 · 琼斯 英伟达董事会主席 Dear NVIDIA Employees, I am writing to share an important update. Jensen has resigned as CEO and Board Member, and the Board has asked our Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress to serve as interim CEO while it conducts a search for a permanent successor looking at both internal and external candidates. I will serve as the first-ever Chair of the Board. As CFO for over 13 years, Colette has been a key architect of NVIDIA’s growth and capital strategy. She possesses a deep understanding of this business and the markets in which we operate. The Board has full confidence in Colette to deliver on our commitments to shareholders, customers, partners, and to each of you. Jensen’s contributions to NVIDIA are profound. NVIDIA is one of the most consequential technology companies in the world. We pioneered accelerated computing, defined the modern GPU, and built the platform that powered artificial intelligence. The Board takes seriously our duty as stewards of this great company. The strength of this company resides in our employees, leadership team, technical strength and partner ecosystem. items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 12, after Jensen Huang resigned as NVIDIA's president, CEO and board member, Harvey Jones, NVIDIA's first board chair, issued an internal memo to employees. Jones has over 30 years of entrepreneurship, technology management and venture capital experience, and previously served as CEO and executive chairman of Synopsys. Reuters obtained a copy of the memo; IT之家's translation says Huang has resigned as CEO and board member, the board has appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO while searching for a permanent successor among internal and external candidates, and Jones will serve as the company's first-ever board chair. The memo says Kress has been CFO for over 13 years and is one of the key architects of NVIDIA's growth and capital strategy, and the board has full confidence in her; it also says Huang's contributions are profound, and that NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing, defined the modern GPU and built the platform that powered AI; the company's strength resides in its employees, leadership team, technical strength and partner ecosystem.
items.why_zh: 推测：若备忘录属实，英伟达在AI芯片关键期突然更换CEO，可能引发公司治理与战略连续性关注。
items.why_en: Speculative: if the memo is accurate, NVIDIA's sudden CEO change during a critical period for AI chips could raise governance and strategic continuity concerns.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，英伟达董事会今日宣布，黄仁勋辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事会成员职务，即刻生效。 英伟达执行副总裁兼 CFO 科莱特 · 克雷斯同意出任临时 CEO，在董事会选出正式继任者前兼任这一职务，并继续担任执行副总裁和 CFO。 董事会将启动新任 CEO 的遴选工作，候选人包括 公司内部高管和外部人士 。克雷斯自 2013 年 9 月加入英伟达以来，一直担任执行副总裁兼 CFO，负责领导财务部门。此前，她曾在思科、微软等大型科技企业从事财务工作近 25 年。 董事会同时任命 哈维 ·C· 琼斯为英伟达首任董事长 。琼斯拥有超过 30 年的创业、科技企业管理和风险投资经验，曾任新思科技 CEO 及执行董事长。 英伟达董事长哈维 · 琼斯表示： 科莱特参与领导英伟达实现了非同寻常的高速增长，对公司的业务、客户、运营和财务状况都非常了解。她还有一支经验丰富的管理团队作为支持，这支团队在落实英伟达战略和推进技术路线图方面发挥了重要作用。 董事会 对科莱特和管理团队充满信心 ，相信公司的日常运营、客户承诺和产品开发计划都不会中断。 英伟达临时 CEO 兼 CFO 科莱特 · 克雷斯表示： 员工始终是英伟达的力量源泉。我将与管理团队共同努力，继续发展 黄仁勋过去 33 年为公司奠定的卓越基础 。我们会继续推动英伟达在加速计算和 AI 领域的发展，把握未来的机遇。 服务客户、合作伙伴、开发者和股东仍是我们的工作重心。 官方的新闻稿说， 黄仁勋对英伟达的贡献意义深远 ，董事会及公司对他 为公司及行业所做出的不可估量的贡献 表示感谢。 据IT之家了解，英伟达仍将按原计划于 11 月 17 日（周二）太平洋时间约下午 1:20 发布其 2027 财年第三季度财务业绩，并将于太平洋时间下午 2:00 召开财报电话会议。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov. 12 that Nvidia's board announced Jensen Huang has resigned as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately. Executive Vice President and CFO Colette Kress agreed to serve as interim CEO, holding the role while the board selects a permanent successor, and will continue as EVP and CFO. The board will start a search for a new CEO, with candidates including internal executives and external people. Kress has served as EVP and CFO since joining Nvidia in September 2013 and previously worked in finance at large tech companies including Cisco and Microsoft for nearly 25 years. The board also appointed Harvey C. Jones as Nvidia's first chairman; Jones has more than 30 years of entrepreneurship, tech management and venture capital experience and previously served as CEO and executive chairman of Synopsys. Jones said Kress helped lead Nvidia through extraordinary high-speed growth and understands its business, customers, operations and financial condition, supported by an experienced management team. The board is confident that daily operations, customer commitments and product development plans will not be interrupted. Kress said employees are Nvidia's source of strength, and she will work with the management team to continue building on the foundation Huang laid over the past 33 years and to advance accelerated computing and AI. The official press release said Huang's contributions are far-reaching and the board and company thanked him. Nvidia still plans to report Q3 fiscal 2027 results on Nov. 17 at about 1:20 p.m. PT and hold an earnings call at 2:00 p.m. PT.
items.why_zh: 若该消息属实，这将是英伟达最高层重大变动，可能影响公司战略连续性与市场信心（推测）。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，英伟达董事会今日宣布，黄仁勋辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事会成员职务，即刻生效。 英伟达执行副总裁兼 CFO 科莱特 · 克雷斯同意出任临时 CEO，在董事会选出正式继任者前兼任这一职务，并继续担任执行副总裁和 CFO。 董事会将启动新任 CEO 的遴选工作，候选人包括 公司内部高管和外部人士 。克雷斯自 2013 年 9 月加入英伟达以来，一直担任执行副总裁兼 CFO，负责领导财务部门。此前，她曾在思科、微软等大型科技企业从事财务工作近 25 年。 董事会同时任命 哈维 ·C· 琼斯为英伟达首任董事长 。琼斯拥有超过 30 年的创业、科技企业管理和风险投资经验，曾任新思科技 CEO 及执行董事长。 英伟达董事长哈维 · 琼斯表示： 科莱特参与领导英伟达实现了非同寻常的高速增长，对公司的业务、客户、运营和财务状况都非常了解。她还有一支经验丰富的管理团队作为支持，这支团队在落实英伟达战略和推进技术路线图方面发挥了重要作用。 董事会 对科莱特和管理团队充满信心 ，相信公司的日常运营、客户承诺和产品开发计划都不会中断。 英伟达临时 CEO 兼 CFO 科莱特 · 克雷斯表示： 员工始终是英伟达的力量源泉。我将与管理团队共同努力，继续发展 黄仁勋过去 33 年为公司奠定的卓越基础 。我们会继续推动英伟达在加速计算和 AI 领域的发展，把握未来的机遇。 服务客户、合作伙伴、开发者和股东仍是我们的工作重心。 官方的新闻稿说， 黄仁勋对英伟达的贡献意义深远 ，董事会及公司对他 为公司及行业所做出的不可估量的贡献 表示感谢。 据IT之家了解，英伟达仍将按原计划于 11 月 17 日（周二）太平洋时间约下午 1:20 发布其 2027 财年第三季度财务业绩，并将于太平洋时间下午 2:00 召开财报电话会议。

items.title_zh: 新华三发布全新国产双路旗舰服务器 R4930 G7，单线程 IPC 性能提升超 15%
items.title_en: New H3C Releases New Domestic Dual-Socket Flagship Server R4930 G7, Single-Thread IPC Performance Up Over 15%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，新紫光集团今日宣布，旗下新华三完成 H3C UniServer R4930 G7 服务器核心平台迭代升级。这款自研国产双路旗舰 搭载全新一代国产处理器 ，从计算内核、内存带宽、AI 向量加速到底层 BMC 安全底座全方位跃升。 R4930 G7 单机 最高 192 核，支持 768 线程 ，整机计算性能较上代实现大幅度提升， 单线程 IPC（每时钟周期指令数）性能提升超 15% ，核心规模扩容 50%、线程规模翻倍。 同等机架和功耗下，单机可承载的虚拟机、容器或业务实例明显增加。若上代单机稳定承载 80 个中等负载虚拟机，新平台可提升至约 120 个， 相当于节省一台服务器的采购与机柜占用 。 平台原生兼容 AVX512 指令集，内置 INT8、BF16 AI 加速指令，大模型推理、向量检索、智能分析等负载下算力潜能充分释放，通用业务与智能化业务可同平台混合部署， 减少为 AI 单独建池的资源闲置与架构复杂度。 整机配置 24 根 DDR5 内存，最高速率 6400MT/s，内存频率提升 33%、带宽提升 30%，数据访问时延进一步压低。内存型数据库在同等并发下数据页交换与缓存刷写等待缩短；大模型推理场景中 KV Cache 读写瓶颈缓解，单机可支撑的并发推理请求数同步提升。平台原生支持 CXL2.0，为内存池化、异构资源共享预留演进空间，后续架构升级不必整体替换平台。 据介绍，这款产品在扩展上延续高密度 2U 形态，支持 10 块单宽 GPU 或 4 块双宽 GPU，最多 10 个 PCIe 5.0 插槽；存储最高 41 块硬盘、300T 容量，其中 NVMe 盘最大 28 块。以 300T 裸容量估算，用于视频解析温数据留存，按单路 1080P 每小时约 2GB 占用， 可支撑约 15 万小时视频在线存储 ，减少频繁扩盘带来的运维中断。 IT之家获悉，产品搭载自研国产 BMC 芯片， 叠加 100% 国产化部件底座，部件国产化率 100% 。整机内置独立安全处理器，支持国密 SM3/SM4 算法，暴力破解抵御能力升级；搭配可信平台模块提供高级加密支撑。结合 CPU 内置可信硬件引擎，可落地内存加密、虚拟机隔离、存储链路加密等多层防护，全自研 BIOS、BMC 固件，掌握完整知识产权，从底层规避管控风险。 该产品已完成全栈国产软硬件生态认证，兼容国产操作系统、中间件、云平台与主流国产加速组件，业务迁移改造成本更低，可减少适配验证周期与二次开发投入，广泛支撑政务大模型、金融风控、能源调度、城市视觉分析、企业私有智算等场景。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov. 12 that New Purple Light Group announced its H3C unit completed a core platform iteration of the H3C UniServer R4930 G7 server. This self-developed domestic dual-socket flagship carries a new-generation domestic processor and upgrades compute cores, memory bandwidth, AI vector acceleration and the underlying BMC security base. A single R4930 G7 supports up to 192 cores and 768 threads; overall compute performance is greatly improved over the previous generation, with single-thread IPC up more than 15%, core scale expanded 50% and thread scale doubled. Under the same rack and power, a single unit can carry more VMs, containers or service instances; if the previous generation stably carried 80 medium-load VMs, the new platform can raise that to about 120, equivalent to saving one server purchase and rack space. The platform natively supports AVX512 and includes INT8 and BF16 AI acceleration instructions, releasing compute potential for large-model inference, vector retrieval and intelligent analysis, allowing general and AI services to be deployed on the same platform and reducing resource idle and architectural complexity from separate AI pools. It has 24 DDR5 memory slots at up to 6400MT/s, with memory frequency up 33% and bandwidth up 30%, further reducing data access latency. In-memory databases can shorten page swap and cache flush waits under the same concurrency; in large-model inference, KV Cache read/write bottlenecks are eased and the number of concurrent inference requests per unit rises. The platform natively supports CXL2.0, reserving room for memory pooling and heterogeneous resource sharing without replacing the whole platform in future upgrades. In expansion, it continues a high-density 2U form factor, supports 10 single-width GPUs or 4 dual-width GPUs and up to 10 PCIe 5.0 slots; storage supports up to 41 drives and 300T capacity, including up to 28 NVMe drives. At 300T raw capacity, for retaining warm video-analysis data at about 2GB per 1080P stream per hour, it can support about 150,000 hours of online video storage, reducing operational interruptions from frequent disk expansion. IT Home learned that the product uses a self-developed domestic BMC chip and a 100% domestic component base, with a 100% domestic component rate. It has an independent security processor, supports SM3/SM4 national cryptographic algorithms, improves brute-force resistance, and provides advanced encryption with a trusted platform module. Combined with CPU built-in trusted hardware engines, it can implement memory encryption, VM isolation and storage-link encryption; self-developed BIOS and BMC firmware provide full intellectual property and avoid control risks at the base layer. The product has completed full-stack domestic software and hardware ecosystem certification and is compatible with domestic OSes, middleware, cloud platforms and mainstream domestic acceleration components, lowering migration and adaptation costs and reducing verification cycles and secondary development. It supports scenarios such as government large models, financial risk control, energy scheduling, urban visual analysis and enterprise private intelligent computing.

items.title_en: Presale Early-Bird Price from 157,700 Yuan, Geely Xingyue L PLUS Opens Presale
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，吉利汽车旗下全新中型 SUV 星越 L PLUS 正式启动预售。新车共推出五款配置车型，预售先享价区间为 15.77 万元至 19.97 万元。该车在现款星越 L 的基础上进一步放大了车身尺寸，并支持选装 EVA 实体机器人；预售发布会现场，官方还同步推出了定位顶配的“大师典藏版”车型。 据IT之家了解，星越 L PLUS 的车身长度达到 4955mm，轴距增至 2900mm，整体规格相比现款星越 L 有明显提升。外观方面，新车采用吉利最新的家族化设计语言：前脸为大尺寸盾形格栅，内部以直瀑式镀铬饰条填充，中央镶嵌品牌标识，两侧搭配造型狭长的大灯组；隆起的机舱盖筋线则进一步强化了整车的力量感。 车身侧面提供密辐式与大饼式两种轮圈造型可选，并配备传统样式车门把手及车顶行李架。车尾采用贯穿式尾灯设计，下方辅以吉利品牌英文标识，配合保险杠镀铬装饰与车顶扰流板，层次感较为突出。配色方面，新车提供乌金黑、甜釉白、青韵灰、郎窑绿、霜釉银等在内的六款车色。 作为车系的顶配版本，大师典藏版采用“霁红车身 + 银晖车顶”的双色搭配（官方称之为“流银霁红”），车内则选用栗烟红真皮内饰，并配备大饼式静音轮圈。细节方面，该车在 D 柱设有大师版专属 LOGO，开门迎宾灯采用“吉”字祥云造型，辨识度十足。 智能化配置上，新车按车型梯度有所区分。次顶配揽晖至尊版与顶配大师典藏版搭载激光雷达，配备英伟达 Orin-Y 辅助驾驶芯片，采用千里浩瀚 H5 高阶辅助驾驶方案，可实现城市领航辅助（CNOA）、高速领航辅助（HNOA）以及车位到车位领航辅助（D2D）等功能，官方将其概括为“有路就能开、有位就能停”的全场景辅助驾驶能力。 而入门版揽晖悦尊版、次入门揽晖荣尊版及中配揽晖曜尊版则搭载地平线征程系列辅助驾驶芯片，支持 ACC 全速自适应巡航、ICC 智能巡航辅助、APA 智能泊车辅助和 RPA 遥控泊车辅助等主流功能。值得一提的是，新车车顶集成激光雷达模组，整车共配备 27 个高感知智驾硬件。 车内采用全新设计风格：内嵌式全液晶仪表盘搭配三辐式多功能方向盘，中控屏与副驾娱乐屏组成一体式连屏，科技感突出。其他配置还包括游艇式电子换挡杆、HUD 抬头显示、圆角矩形空调出风口以及带菱形纹理的皮质座椅。新车支持六屏联动，部分配置车型可选装“超级 EVA 智能体”。内饰提供栗烟红真皮、丹霞棕环保麂皮、云舒米皮质三种配色方案。 空间与舒适性方面，官方数据显示车内共设 39 处储物空间，后备厢容积 740L 且可进一步拓展，并配备冷暖箱、小桌板、空调出风口、后排座椅电动调节及“二排贵妃榻”等配置，覆盖通勤与长途出行等多种场景。座椅方面提供云感 SPA 座椅，音响系统则为 23 扬声器 Flyme Sound 无界之声。 动力系统上，星越 L PLUS 搭载吉利 i-HEV 智擎混动系统，由 2.0TD 混动高效发动机与 3DHT 12 合 1 电驱组成，发动机最大功率 160kW，极速 190km/h，主打低油耗表现。 底盘方面，新车采用前双叉臂 + 后五连杆独立悬架组合，并同级首发搭载后轮转向系统，最小转弯半径仅 4.88 米，还支持蟹行模式。此外，车辆配备双腔闭式空气悬架，可根据路况自适应调节悬架软硬与车身高度，在操控性与舒适性之间实现动态平衡。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov. 12 that Geely Auto's all-new midsize SUV, the Xingyue L PLUS, officially opened presale. The model comes in five trims, with presale early-bird prices ranging from 157,700 yuan to 199,700 yuan. Based on the current Xingyue L, it further enlarges the body and supports an optional EVA physical robot; at the presale event, the company also introduced a top-trim “Master Collection Edition.” The Xingyue L PLUS is 4955mm long with a 2900mm wheelbase, a clear increase over the current Xingyue L. Exterior design uses Geely's latest family language: a large shield-shaped grille with vertical chrome strips, a central brand badge and narrow headlights on both sides; raised hood creases add a sense of strength. The side offers two wheel designs, dense-spoke and “big pie” style, plus conventional door handles and roof rails. The rear has a full-width taillight design, the Geely English brand mark below, chrome bumper trim and a roof spoiler for layered visuals. Six colors are offered, including Wujin Black, Sweet Glaze White, Qingyun Gray, Langyao Green and Frost Glaze Silver. As the top trim, the Master Collection Edition uses a two-tone “霁红 body + 银晖 roof” combination (officially called “流银霁红”), a chestnut-red leather interior and “big pie” quiet wheels. It has a Master Edition-specific logo on the D-pillar and a welcome light with a “吉” character and auspicious-cloud shape. Smart features differ by trim. The second-from-top Lanhui Supreme Edition and top Master Collection Edition carry lidar, Nvidia Orin-Y driver-assistance chips and the Qianli Haohan H5 advanced driver-assistance system, enabling city navigation assist (CNOA), highway navigation assist (HNOA) and door-to-door navigation assist (D2D), summarized by the company as all-scenario assistance that can “drive wherever there is a road and park wherever there is a space.” The entry Lanhui Yue Supreme Edition, second-entry Lanhui Rong Supreme Edition and mid Lanhui Yao Supreme Edition use Horizon Journey series driver-assistance chips and support ACC full-speed adaptive cruise, ICC intelligent cruise assist, APA intelligent parking assist and RPA remote parking assist. The roof integrates a lidar module, and the vehicle has 27 high-perception driver-assistance hardware units. The interior adopts a new design: an embedded full-LCD instrument panel with a three-spoke multi-function steering wheel, and a central screen integrated with a passenger entertainment screen. Other features include a yacht-style electronic shifter, HUD, rounded rectangular air vents and leather seats with diamond texture. The car supports six-screen linkage, and some trims can be optioned with a “Super EVA agent.” Interior color schemes include chestnut-red leather, Danxia Brown eco-suede and Yunshu Mi leather. For space and comfort, official data show 39 storage spaces, a 740L trunk that can be expanded, and a heating/cooling box, small table, air vents, power-adjustable rear seats and a “second-row lounge seat.” Seats are Cloud-SPA seats, and audio is a 23-speaker Flyme Sound system. Power comes from Geely's i-HEV hybrid system, combining a 2.0TD high-efficiency hybrid engine and a 3DHT 12-in-1 electric drive; the engine has a maximum power of 160kW, top speed is 190km/h, and the focus is low fuel consumption. The chassis uses front double wishbone and rear five-link independent suspension, and is the first in its class with rear-wheel steering, a minimum turning radius of only 4.88 meters and crab mode. It also has dual-chamber closed air suspension that adaptively adjusts stiffness and body height to balance handling and comfort.

items.title_en: Before Affair Scandal Erupted, Jensen Huang Discussed Succession: Hopes Next CEO Comes From Inside Nvidia
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在婚外情风波震动公司前数周， 曾谈到自己的接班问题 。在 10 月 14 日录制、今天发布的彭博社《The Circuit》节目采访中，黄仁勋谈及自己的继任安排：“ 就像我可能被解雇一样，下一任 CEO 也得由公司聘请 。” 执掌英伟达 33 年的黄仁勋有一双儿女，且都在英伟达从事工作。女儿黄敏珊担任具身智能产品营销高级总监，儿子黄胜斌则担任机器人产品总监。 在被问及女儿是否会接自己的班时，黄仁勋回答：“首先，我并不希望她接手这份工作。因为如果黄胜斌或黄敏珊有这样的志向， 就必须靠自己去争取 。” 综合IT之家近期的报道，这段采访内容公开之际，英伟达经历了动荡的一周。先是在 9 日，黄仁勋承认自己对妻子“不忠”；再是今天早些时候，《纽约时报》援引 5 名前员工消息称，黄仁勋还曾与直接向他汇报的英伟达医疗保健业务副总裁金伯利 · 鲍威尔发生过另一段婚外情。 《华尔街日报》则报道称，英伟达董事会正准备撤换黄仁勋。消息传出后，英伟达股价盘后交易一度下跌 8%。 英伟达的管理架构以扁平化著称，黄仁勋直接管理的下属 多达 60 人 ，外界很难判断谁才是公司真正的二号人物。 黄仁勋接受彭博社采访时，谈到了接班安排和 CEO 的责任。他希望下一任 CEO 来自英伟达内部，自己当时 也没有近期离职的打算 ：“我真心希望下一任 CEO 已经在公司内部。不过，20 年后，我希望自己依然健康，也希望还能继续为公司创造价值。” 采访披露，培养出英伟达自己的下一任 CEO，也是黄仁勋的职责：“我们应该为公司的持续发展创造条件，并确保下一任领导者已经在英伟达内部任职。” 谈到 CEO 一职所承担的责任，黄仁勋强调：“我肩负着整个行业的责任。担任 CEO 的压力很大，而且这种压力本来就应该很大。”
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov. 12 that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had discussed his succession weeks before an affair scandal shook the company. In a Bloomberg “The Circuit” interview recorded on Oct. 14 and published today, Huang discussed his succession arrangements: “Just as I could be fired, the next CEO also has to be hired by the company.” Huang, who has led Nvidia for 33 years, has a son and a daughter, both working at Nvidia. His daughter Huang Min Shan is senior director of embodied intelligence product marketing, and his son Huang Sheng Bin is director of robotics products. Asked whether his daughter would succeed him, Huang replied: “First, I don't want her to take this job. Because if Huang Sheng Bin or Huang Min Shan has such an ambition, they must earn it themselves.” According to IT Home's recent reports, the interview was published as Nvidia went through a turbulent week. First, on the 9th, Huang admitted he had been “unfaithful” to his wife; then earlier today, The New York Times, citing five former employees, reported that Huang had another affair with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia's vice president of healthcare who reported directly to him. The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia's board was preparing to replace Huang. After the news, Nvidia shares fell as much as 8% in after-hours trading. Nvidia is known for a flat management structure, with Huang directly managing as many as 60 people, making it hard for outsiders to identify the company's true No. 2. In the Bloomberg interview, Huang discussed succession and the responsibilities of a CEO. He hoped the next CEO would come from inside Nvidia and said he had no plans to leave soon: “I sincerely hope the next CEO is already inside the company. But 20 years from now, I hope I am still healthy and can continue to create value for the company.” The interview revealed that cultivating Nvidia's own next CEO is also Huang's responsibility: “We should create conditions for the company's continued development and ensure that the next leader is already working inside Nvidia.” On the responsibilities of the CEO role, Huang stressed: “I bear responsibility for the entire industry. The pressure of being CEO is great, and it should be great.”

items.title_en: Jensen Huang is out. What did China want from him?
items.summary_zh: 该播客称，今天讨论英伟达的黄仁勋丑闻，事态发展太快，以至于在发布前几分钟紧急更新了开场；黄仁勋刚刚辞去英伟达CEO职务，有关其婚外情（包括与一名据称的中国间谍）的消息可能吞没公司。节目称将持续跟进，并了解英伟达在黄仁勋之后如何重组——他曾有约60名直接下属，而整个AI金融生态都流经该公司。节目称两天前主持人曾与布鲁金斯学会约翰·桑顿中国中心外交政策研究员Kyle Chan讨论丑闻核心：中国若在黄仁勋身边安插间谍，究竟想达成什么？美中AI冲突的真实状态如何，尤其从中国视角看？Kyle关于芯片和中国如何看待所谓AI“竞赛”的回答很有启发性，但或许更有趣的是他对黄仁勋与特朗普关系的观察——也许中国最可能获得的是一个能在正确耳边低语的人。节目提醒，录制时仍不知道黄仁勋会发生什么。随后进入对Kyle Chan的采访，讨论英伟达、中国与AI出口管制的未来。采访为篇幅和清晰度做过轻度编辑。以上为播客叙述，相关说法未经独立核实。
items.summary_en: Today, we’re talking about the Jensen Huang scandal at Nvidia, which is developing so quickly that we had to do an emergency update of this intro minutes before publishing this episode. Huang just resigned from his position as CEO of Nvidia as news of his affairs, including with an alleged Chinese spy, threatened to engulf the company. We’ll have more on that story as things develop and we learn how Nvidia will restructure itself after Jensen — he had something like 60 direct reports, after all, and the entire AI financial ecosystem flows through the company. This is pure Decoder bait. But just two days ago I talked to Kyle Chan, a foreign policy fellow at the Brookings Institution’s John L. Thornton China Center, about the real heart of the scandal: What would China even seek to accomplish by having a spy so close to Jensen? And what does the real state of the US-China AI conflict really looks like, particularly from the Chinese point of view? Kyle’s answers about chips and how China is perceiving the so-called AI “race” were very illuminating, but maybe even more interesting was his observation on Jensen Huang’s relationship with Trump was the most important thing of all — because maybe what China most stood to gain was someone who could whisper in the right ears. items.title_zh: 黄仁勋辞职后，特朗普呼吁苹果执行董事长库克接任英伟达 CEO
items.title_en: After Jensen Huang Resigns, Trump Calls on Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook to Succeed Him as Nvidia CEO
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，黄仁勋离任英伟达 CEO 后，美国总统特朗普随即呼吁苹果执行董事长蒂姆 · 库克接掌英伟达。 今天（12 日）晚间，特朗普在 Truth Social 发文称， 能够接替黄仁勋的人“只有一个”—— 苹果公司的蒂姆 · 库克 。“一位传奇来接替另一位传奇！” 据IT之家了解，卸任苹果 CEO 后，库克改任执行董事长。 黄仁勋辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事会成员职务后，英伟达任命执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特 · 克雷斯（Colette Kress）为临时 CEO。 在正式继任者确定之前，克雷斯在代行首席执行官职责的同时，将继续兼任执行副总裁兼首席财务官。 董事会目前已启动正式首席执行官的遴选工作，并将统筹考虑内部及外部候选人 。 相关阅读： 《 黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO 重创全球 AI 概念股，AMD、博通逆势上涨 》 《 黄仁勋辞去 CEO 后，英伟达首任董事会主席哈维 · 琼斯发表内部信 》 《 英伟达临时 CEO 科莱特 · 克雷斯发表内部信：我对公司、对未来充满信心，你们是最宝贵的力量 》 《 黄仁勋辞去 CEO 后，英伟达市值失守 4 万亿美元 》 《 黄仁勋辞任 CEO 后，英伟达称维持原定时间公布 2027 财年三季度财报 》 《 黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO，公司美股盘前跌幅扩大至 10% 》 《 黄仁勋辞去 CEO 后，英伟达任命执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特 · 克雷斯为临时首席执行官 》 《 即刻生效！黄仁勋辞去英伟达总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员职务 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 12 news: After Jensen Huang left the CEO role at Nvidia, U.S. President Trump immediately called on Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook to take over Nvidia. On the evening of the 12th, Trump posted on Truth Social that there is “only one” person who can succeed Jensen Huang — Apple’s Tim Cook. “One legend succeeds another!” According to IT之家, after stepping down as Apple CEO, Cook changed to executive chairman. After Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member, Nvidia appointed Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO. Before a formal successor is determined, Kress will continue to serve concurrently as EVP and CFO while performing CEO duties. The board has launched a formal CEO search and will consider both internal and external candidates. Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia President, CEO and Board Member.”

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，黄仁勋离任英伟达 CEO 后，美国总统特朗普随即呼吁苹果执行董事长蒂姆 · 库克接掌英伟达。 今天（12 日）晚间，特朗普在 Truth Social 发文称， 能够接替黄仁勋的人“只有一个”—— 苹果公司的蒂姆 · 库克 。“一位传奇来接替另一位传奇！” 据IT之家了解，卸任苹果 CEO 后，库克改任执行董事长。 黄仁勋辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事会成员职务后，英伟达任命执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特 · 克雷斯（Colette Kress）为临时 CEO。 在正式继任者确定之前，克雷斯在代行首席执行官职责的同时，将继续兼任执行副总裁兼首席财务官。 董事会目前已启动正式首席执行官的遴选工作，并将统筹考虑内部及外部候选人 。 相关阅读： 《 黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO 重创全球 AI 概念股，AMD、博通逆势上涨 》 《 黄仁勋辞去 CEO 后，英伟达首任董事会主席哈维 · 琼斯发表内部信 》 《 英伟达临时 CEO 科莱特 · 克雷斯发表内部信：我对公司、对未来充满信心，你们是最宝贵的力量 》 《 黄仁勋辞去 CEO 后，英伟达市值失守 4 万亿美元 》 《 黄仁勋辞任 CEO 后，英伟达称维持原定时间公布 2027 财年三季度财报 》 《 黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO，公司美股盘前跌幅扩大至 10% 》 《 黄仁勋辞去 CEO 后，英伟达任命执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特 · 克雷斯为临时首席执行官 》 《 即刻生效！黄仁勋辞去英伟达总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员职务 》

items.title_zh: 谷歌为 Android XR 智能眼镜推出全面隐私保护措施：录制指示灯、人脸模糊与数据即删
items.title_en: Google Rolls Out Comprehensive Privacy Protections for Android XR Smart Glasses: Recording Indicator, Face Blurring, and Immediate Data Deletion
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，谷歌与 Warby Parker、Gentle Monster 合作推出的首款 Android XR 智能眼镜，正面临一个不太容易解决的问题：如何摆脱消费者对智能眼镜的隐私担忧。 由于早期进入这一领域的厂商没有充分重视隐私保护，智能眼镜逐渐背上了“偷拍眼镜”的负面标签。部分用户甚至将其视为侵犯他人隐私的工具。 以 Meta 智能眼镜为例，这款产品曾因被不法分子滥用而饱受争议。一些人会设法关闭眼镜上用于提示正在拍摄的 LED 指示灯，或者利用眼镜做出令人反感的行为。Meta 此前对录制内容的处理方式也曾引发隐私争议。这些问题叠加在一起，让消费者对智能眼镜产生了不信任，也使其背上了负面社会标签。 谷歌其实也不是毫无前车之鉴。早在第一代 Google Glass 推出时，用户就曾因佩戴这款眼镜而遭到嘲讽，甚至被冠以“Glasshole”（可理解为戴着智能眼镜四处惹人反感的人）的称呼。显然，谷歌从当年的经历中吸取了不少教训。 这其实有些可惜，因为摄像头对于智能眼镜而言具有很强的实用价值。用户可以用它随手拍照，而内置 AI 助手也能借助摄像头理解用户眼前的环境。但如今由于隐私争议，这项功能反而让人觉得有些不自在。 带着这样的背景，来看看谷歌准备如何处理这个敏感问题。 首先，所有 Android XR 智能眼镜都配备了一个朝外的指示灯，其作用与 Meta 智能眼镜上的隐私 LED 类似。不过，两者有一个重要区别：Android XR 眼镜上的指示灯实际上是“录制指示灯”。 只要眼镜正在拍摄能够以某种形式保存、供用户日后查看的内容，指示灯就会亮起。例如，用户拍照或录制视频时，指示灯都会启动。 但如果用户只是调用 Gemini 获取周围环境的信息，指示灯则不会亮起。这是因为，所有用于 Gemini 的摄像头画面都会在使用后立即删除。这些图像不会出现在 Gemini 的聊天记录中，而且用户也无法选择保留。换句话说，无论用户还是谷歌，都无法在之后重新调用这些图像。 谷歌还明确表示，不会将 Gemini 获取的这些图像用于 AI 模型训练或广告投放。此外，用户可以自行控制 Android XR 眼镜上的哪些应用有权使用摄像头。 更重要的是，谷歌还专门考虑了如何防止有人擅自破坏指示灯的隐私保护功能。 Android XR 眼镜会定期自动执行系统检查，确认指示灯是否正常工作。用户在给眼镜充电时，可能会看到指示灯交替闪烁白光和蓝光，这实际上就是系统在检查相关硬件是否运行正常。如果系统发现指示灯出现故障，眼镜就会自动禁用摄像头。 另一项让人印象深刻的设计，是谷歌对周围其他人的隐私保护。 当用户通过 Intelligent Eyewear 将照片发送给 Gemini 时，手机会在照片发送之前，自动对画面中的人脸进行模糊处理。这项操作直接在手机本地完成，属于智能眼镜配套应用的一部分。 类似地，发送给 Gemini 的语音数据也会经过过滤，尽可能去除用户本人以外的其他人的声音。 语音过滤只是谷歌利用麦克风实现隐私保护的一个例子。另一个例子是实时翻译功能：该功能主要针对用户前方 60 度范围内的声音进行识别，同时过滤周围环境中的其他声音。 在摄像头与 Gemini 的交互方式上，谷歌还向 9to5Google 解释称，Gemini 经过专门调整，不会在用户没有明确表达意图时随意调用摄像头。 例如，用户询问“这幅画是什么”，显然意味着希望眼镜观察眼前的场景，并识别这件艺术品。在这种情况下，Gemini 可以直接调用摄像头。 但如果用户问的是“桌子上有多少钱”，谷歌认为，仅凭这句话还不能确定用户是否希望启用摄像头。因此，Gemini 会先向用户追问确认，而不是直接拍摄眼前的画面。 除了摄像头调用机制，谷歌还通过限制录制时长来降低智能眼镜被滥用的风险。 谷歌将 Intelligent Eyewear 的单次视频录制时长限制在 90 秒以内。这确实会限制用户的部分使用场景，但谷歌表示，大多数实际录制任务本来就不会超过这一时长。作为对比，Meta 智能眼镜支持最长 5 分钟的视频录制。 除了智能眼镜配套应用和 Gemini 本身，谷歌还表示，将通过旗下其他产品和服务采取措施，防止 Android XR 眼镜的摄像头遭到滥用，具体包括： 负责任使用要…
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 12 news: Google’s first Android XR smart glasses, launched in partnership with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, face a not-so-easy problem: how to shake off consumers’ privacy concerns about smart glasses. Because early entrants did not pay sufficient attention to privacy protection, smart glasses gradually acquired the negative label of “spy glasses.” Some users even regard them as tools that invade others’ privacy. Take Meta’s smart glasses as an example; the product has been controversial because it was abused by malicious actors. Some people try to turn off the LED indicator used to signal recording, or use the glasses to do objectionable things. Meta’s previous handling of recorded content has also sparked privacy controversy. Together these issues have created consumer distrust of smart glasses and given them a negative social label. Google is not without precedent. As early as the first-generation Google Glass, users were mocked for wearing the glasses and even called “Glasshole” (roughly, a person who wears smart glasses and annoys people around them). Clearly Google has learned lessons from that experience. This is actually somewhat regrettable, because the camera has strong practical value for smart glasses. Users can take casual photos, and the built-in AI assistant can use the camera to understand the environment in front of the user. But now, due to privacy controversy, this feature instead makes some people feel uneasy. Against this background, let’s look at how Google plans to handle this sensitive issue. First, all Android XR smart glasses are equipped with an outward-facing indicator, similar in function to the privacy LED on Meta smart glasses. But there is an important difference: the indicator on Android XR glasses is actually a “recording indicator.” As long as the glasses are capturing content that can be saved in some form for the user to view later, the indicator will light up. For example, when the user takes a photo or records video, the indicator starts. But if the user only invokes Gemini to get information about the surrounding environment, the indicator will not light up. This is because all camera images used for Gemini are deleted immediately after use. These images do not appear in Gemini chat history, and users cannot choose to retain them. In other words, neither the user nor Google can later retrieve these images. Google also explicitly stated that it will not use these images obtained by Gemini for AI model training or advertising. In addition, users can control which apps on Android XR glasses have permission to use the camera. More importantly, Google has specifically considered how to prevent people from unauthorized tampering with the indicator’s privacy protection function. Android XR glasses regularly and automatically perform system checks to confirm whether the indicator is working properly. When users charge the glasses, they may see the indicator flash alternating white and blue light; this is actually the system checking whether the relevant hardware is operating normally. If the system finds the indicator has failed, the glasses will automatically disable the camera. Another impressive design is Google’s protection of the privacy of people around the user. When a user sends a photo to Gemini via Intelligent Eyewear, the phone automatically blurs faces in the image before the photo is sent. This operation is completed locally on the phone and is part of the companion app for the smart glasses. Similarly, voice data sent to Gemini is also filtered to remove, as much as possible, voices other than the user’s own. Voice filtering is just one example of Google using the microphone for privacy protection. Another example is the real-time translation feature: it mainly recognizes sounds within 60 degrees in front of the user while filtering out other ambient sounds. Regarding how the camera interacts with Gemini, Google also explained to 9to5Google that Gemini has been specially tuned not to invoke the camera arbitrarily when the user has not clearly expressed an intent. For example, if the user asks “What is this painting?”, it clearly means they want the glasses to observe the scene in front of them and identify the artwork. In this case, Gemini can directly invoke the camera. But if the user asks “How much money is on the table?”, Google believes that this sentence alone cannot determine whether the user wants to enable the camera. Therefore, Gemini will first ask the user for confirmation instead of directly capturing the scene in front of them. In addition to the camera invocation mechanism, Google also reduces the risk of smart glasses abuse by limiting recording duration. Google limits a single video recording on Intelligent Eyewear to 90 seconds or less. This does restrict some user scenarios, but Google says most actual recording tasks would not exceed this duration anyway. By comparison, Meta smart glasses support video recording of up to 5 minutes. items.summary_zh: 嗨！我是 Jen Tuohy，The Verge 的高级智能家居评测员。我测试过亚马逊和谷歌迄今推出的每一款智能显示屏，过去一周我一直在测试苹果的首款产品：售价 299 美元的 HomeView。我在厨房台面、床头柜、办公室和咖啡桌上测试了桌面版和壁挂版。我还在玄关安装了一台作为智能家居控制面板。我用它做饭、通过它运行智能家居、用它接电话，并测试了其新的 Siri AI 能力。我也让家人随意使用它，我那位不太懂技术的丈夫很喜欢它。我十几岁的女儿则没那么喜欢。（问我为什么）。查看 t … 在 The Verge 阅读完整故事。
items.summary_en: Getting up close and personal with the Apple HomeView. | Photo: Hunter McRae for The Verge Hi! I'm Jen Tuohy, The Verge's senior smart home reviewer. I've tested every smart display Amazon and Google have ever made, and for the past week I've been testing Apple's first: The $299 HomeView. I put the tabletop and wall-mounted versions through their paces, on my kitchen counter, bedside table, in my office, and on my coffee table. I also mounted one as a smart home control panel in my entryway. I cooked with it, ran my smart home from it, took calls on it, and tested its new Siri AI capabilities. I also let my family loose on it, and my tech-averse husband was a big fan. My teenage daughter, less so. (Ask me why). View t … Read the full story at The Verge.
